score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on current 2026 GOV.UK/Planning Inspectorate plan-making guidance and explicit separation of new-system procedural status, legacy transition and adopted development-plan effect.

sources.label: Create or update a local plan using the new system
sources.fact: 2026 regulations are in force from 25 March 2026; the collection is current guidance for new-system plan preparation.

sources.label: Rollout of the new local plan-making system
sources.fact: Updated 6 March 2026; new system in force from 25 March 2026 with legacy/new systems running in parallel during transition.

sources.label: Legacy submission deadline
sources.fact: Planning Inspectorate guidance states the last date for local plan submissions under legacy regulations is 31 December 2026.

sources.label: New-style local plan examination
sources.fact: Published 18 June 2026; describes the examination process under the 2026 regulations.

sources.label: PINS new-style local plan collection
sources.fact: Published 18 June 2026; collection applies to new-style local-plan examinations and separates them from legacy-system guidance.

sources.label: Legacy local plan examination guidance
sources.fact: Current guidance directs new-system plans to separate guidance and confirms both systems operate concurrently during 2026 transition.

sources.label: Plan-making and local government reorganisation
sources.fact: Published 6 July 2026 and explicitly labelled draft guidance/statement of intention rather than finalised policy.

sources.label: National plan-making policy revision status
sources.fact: The December 2025 revised NPPF was published for consultation; the collection says government anticipates responding/publishing an update in summer 2026.

sources.label: Current NPPF sustainable development
sources.fact: Current decision-making policy remains the published NPPF text until a later revision is actually published and effective.

sources.label: Current London Plan
sources.fact: London Plan 2021 remains the current adopted spatial development strategy for London.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: Adopted 18 September 2024 and remains current local development-plan evidence unless formally superseded.

sources.label: PINS housing land supply evidence
sources.fact: Published 1 June 2026; transitional arrangements can make different NPPF versions relevant to legacy plan examinations.

examples.result: New plan-making regulations being in force do not mean every authority has adopted a new-system local plan.
Legacy and new systems are kept separate; a plan cannot silently jump between procedural regimes.
31 December 2026 is treated as a legacy submission deadline, not an automatic adoption date.
6 July 2026 local-government-reorganisation guidance remains explicitly DRAFT/intention evidence.
December 2025 NPPF consultation draft is not substituted for current published NPPF decision policy.
London Plan 2021 remains current adopted strategic policy while next-plan work proceeds.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 remains adopted evidence and is not displaced merely by national procedural reform.
No parcel promotion occurs from plan-making procedural status without an adopted policy/site relation.
